name: Rear Guard Patrol
summary: At the Bulwark, Deathguard Linnea sends you to guard Tirisfal's eastern flank. Scourge horrors and lingering spirits haunt Balnir Farmstead, where they threaten the road and the supply lines that keep the front supplied.

sections.title: Securing the Bulwark's Flank
sections.body: The Bulwark holds back the pestilence and armies of the Western Plaguelands from Tirisfal Glades. Deathguard Linnea oversees security behind the frontier. The defenders cannot spare troops to guard against attacks from the rear. Any undead that slip past the choke point must be destroyed before they can cut the supply lines feeding the front.

sections.title: The Ruins of Balnir Farmstead
sections.body: Balnir Farmstead was once a working farm in eastern Tirisfal, but it fell to ruin during the Third War. Blight covers its fields, and its crumbling stables shelter Bleeding Horrors and restless Wandering Spirits. Clearing the farmstead denies the Lich King a place to gather forces inside Tirisfal and keeps the road open for Horde reinforcements.

faq.q: Why is this patrol important for the Bulwark?
faq.answer: The Bulwark holds the narrow pass between Tirisfal and the Western Plaguelands. If Scourge wander behind the fortification, defenders could face attacks from both sides and lose the supply lines to Brill and the Undercity.
Deathguard Linnea, stationed near the road east into the Plaguelands, orders the patrol and sends reports of success to Executor Zygand.

faq.q: What creatures haunt the Balnir Farmstead?
faq.answer: Bleeding Horrors, corpses reanimated and stitched together by necromancy, and Wandering Spirits haunt Balnir Farmstead. The spirits belonged to former inhabitants who died during the Scourge's initial conquest.
Executor Zygand is a senior Forsaken Deathguard commander based in Brill. He is Deathguard Linnea's superior.

faq.q: Why don't the Forsaken just abandon the eastern border?
faq.answer: If the Forsaken abandon the Bulwark, the Scourge's endless hordes from the Plaguelands could reach all of Tirisfal Glades and the gates of the Undercity.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you depend on the Bulwark's rear defenses for survival. Clearing Scourge from Balnir Farmstead helps keep the Lich King's renewed grasp from reaching your homeland.
As a member of the Horde, you help hold Tirisfal's eastern perimeter and protect the Horde's tenuous foothold in the northern Eastern Kingdoms from the undead legions.
